title: Serial I-O
body:
[[UART]]
Serial I-O can be either [[Synchronous]] or [[Asynchronous]]
*Synchronous* is *always* sending bits, while *Asynchronous* is *not* always sending a signal.

Connection to a *Keyboard* is a serial connection.

**Use of shift registers**
Serial communication uses [[Shift Register]]s
